name: io.github.ll011702pf/open-joytish-mcp
title: Open Jyotish
description: Vedic astrology (Jyotish) charting over MCP: sidereal positions with 47 ayanamsha modes, 20 vargas (D1-D60), Vimshottari dasha, panchanga, ashtakavarga, yogas and doshas, computed with Swiss Ephemeris. Includes probe_ayanamsha to align configurations against JHora or other software baselines.
